_note: Overhaul v3 review pool (engineering 3.2.4, blueprint 3.5 and 6.3). Every Google text here is copied verbatim from the client's own files (the v2 page data in _data/pages/*.json, which carried the live site's quotes); none is retyped or edited. Templates print a review ONLY when platform is google AND featurable is true (lib/eleventy-ws5.js featured(), which throws if a template asks for a non-Google text). featurable false carries the reason from blueprint 6.3 or status.md. Yelp reviews are recorded by name only, with no text, so Yelp wording can never reach a page (Yelp Terms 5.3 and 7.2.9, status.md standing risk). verified_on stays null until someone re-reads that review on the live Google listing (blueprint 3.2: every one re-read on Google before use); month_year stays null because no file records it. services: which lanes a review may appear in (car, home, blinds, chip, windshield, commercial, ceramic, clearbra, general).
